items.title: AI-synthesized faces are indistinguishable from real faces and more trustworthy

judge.evidence_topic: Our evaluation of the photorealism of AI-synthesized faces indicates that synthesis engines have passed through the uncanny valley and are capable of creating faces that are indistinguishable-and more trustworthy-than real faces.
judge.evidence_empirical: Our evaluation of the photorealism of AI-synthesized faces indicates that synthesis engines have passed through the uncanny valley and are capable of creating faces that are indistinguishable-and more trustworthy-than real faces.

items.title: Voice clones sound realistic but not (yet) hyperrealistic

judge.evidence_topic: We investigated the extent to which AI-generated voices sound real to human listeners, and whether listeners can accurately distinguish between human and AI-generated voices.
judge.evidence_empirical: We tested these questions using AI-generated voices generated with and without a specific human counterpart (i.e., voice clones, and voices generated from the latent space of a large voice model).
judge.reason: O artigo é um estudo empírico com participantes humanos sobre a percepção de vozes sintéticas, atendendo aos critérios. O achado principal está claramente presente no resumo.

items.title: Training human super-recognizers' detection and discrimination of AI-generated faces

judge.evidence_topic: Here, we investigate synthetic face detection and discrimination in super-recognizers (SRs; who have exceptional face recognition skills), and typical-ability control participants.
judge.evidence_empirical: In two different experimental designs, we found that SRs (total N = 283) were better at detecting and discriminating synthetic faces than controls (total N = 381)
judge.reason: O artigo é um estudo empírico com participantes humanos sobre a detecção de rostos sintéticos, atendendo aos critérios de inclusão. Os dados extraídos refletem fielmente o resumo e o achado principal é sustentado pelo texto.

items.title: What you see is not what you get anymore: a mixed-methods approach on human perception of AI-generated images

judge.evidence_topic: This study explores human perception and detection capabilities regarding AI-generated images of landscapes, architecture, and interiors using a mixed-methods approach.
judge.evidence_empirical: A total of 104 participants took part in an online survey, classifying 50 images (25 real, 25 AI-generated) from five leading TTI models.
judge.reason: O artigo é um estudo empírico com participantes humanos que investiga a percepção de imagens geradas por IA, atendendo aos critérios de inclusão e exclusão. Os dados extraídos refletem fielmente o resumo.

items.title: AI-generated images of familiar faces are indistinguishable from real photographs

judge.evidence_topic: Here, we investigated a new method for generating face images (via ChatGPT plus DALL·E) and its application to both fictional and real (in this case, celebrity) identities.
judge.evidence_empirical: Our results demonstrated that generated images of both fictional (Experiment 1) and celebrity identities (Experiment 2) could not be distinguished from real photographs. Further, providing additional real photographs for comparison during the task resulted in limited gains (Experiments 3 and 4).
judge.reason: O artigo é um estudo empírico com participantes humanos sobre a percepção de imagens sintéticas, atendendo aos critérios. Os dados extraídos refletem corretamente o conteúdo do resumo, incluindo a ausência da informação sobre o tamanho da amostra.

items.title: Deepfake smiles matter less—the psychological and neural impact of presumed AI-generated faces

judge.evidence_topic: Here we investigate the impact of the belief that depicted persons are real or deepfakes on psychological and neural measures of human face perception.
judge.evidence_empirical: Using EEG, we tracked participants’ (N = 30) brain responses to real faces showing positive, neutral, and negative expressions, after being informed that they are either real or fake.
judge.reason: O estudo é empírico, focado na percepção humana de deepfakes, sem envolver política, saúde ou algoritmos de detecção automática. O método e o achado estão corretamente descritos e sustentados pelo resumo.

judge.evidence_topic: This article conducted two randomized controlled 2 × 2 × 2 experiments ( N = 518) to explore the influence of heuristic cues (including the number of followers, popularity, and description as variables) generated by the system and video characteristics (including definition, duration, and editing as variables).
judge.evidence_empirical: This article conducted two randomized controlled 2 × 2 × 2 experiments ( N = 518)
judge.reason: O artigo é um estudo empírico com participantes humanos que investiga a percepção de credibilidade de deepfakes, alinhando-se ao tema. O método descrito no resumo corresponde ao extraído, e o achado principal é sustentado pelo texto do resumo.

items.title: Interpretation of AI-Generated vs. Human-Made Images

judge.evidence_topic: The goal of this study was to examine whether image interpretation is influenced by the origin of the image (AI-generated vs. human-made). Additionally, we aimed to explore whether visual professionalization influences how images are interpreted.
judge.evidence_empirical: To this end, we presented 24 AI-generated images (produced using Midjourney, DALL·E, and Firefly) and 8 human-made images to 161 participants-71 visual professionals and 90 non-professionals.
judge.reason: O artigo é um estudo empírico com participantes humanos que avalia a percepção de credibilidade e realismo de imagens geradas por IA, atendendo aos critérios do pedido. Os achados extraídos estão diretamente sustentados pelo resumo.
